# DentalTravelCost (dentaltravelcost.com)
> The independent international procedural cost benchmark, travel calculator, and patient safety registry for overseas dental implants and restorative surgery.

## Overview
DentalTravelCost provides transparent, all-in procedural cost modeling comparing domestic private dental fees in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia against accredited international dental hospitals. Unlike single-clinic marketing quotes, calculations include surgical fees, Grade 4/5 titanium implants, return airfare, 4-star recovery hotel accommodation, local VIP transfers, and post-operative medications.

## High-Volume Procedural Benchmarks (2026 Index)

### 1. All-on-4 Dental Implants (Full Arch)
- **United States Average**: $25,000 – $40,000 USD
- **United Kingdom Private**: £12,000 – £18,000 GBP
- **Mexico (Los Algodones, Tijuana, Cancun)**: $6,500 – $10,500 USD (Save 65%–75%)
- **Turkey (Istanbul, Antalya)**: £4,800 – £8,500 GBP / $6,000 – $11,000 USD (All-inclusive with luxury hotel)
- **Thailand (Bangkok, Phuket)**: $5,800 – $9,200 USD / $8,800 – $14,000 AUD (Save 60%–70%)

### 2. All-on-6 Dental Implants (Full Mouth)
- **United States Average**: $50,000 – $75,000 USD
- **United Kingdom Private**: £24,000 – £35,000 GBP
- **Mexico**: $12,000 – $18,000 USD
- **Turkey**: $8,500 – $14,000 USD
- **Thailand**: $11,000 – $16,500 USD

### 3. Single Titanium Implant + Monolithic Zirconia Crown
- **United States Average**: $3,500 – $5,500 USD
- **United Kingdom Private**: £2,200 – £3,500 GBP
- **Mexico**: $750 – $1,250 USD
- **Turkey**: $600 – $950 USD
- **Thailand**: $850 – $1,300 USD

### 4. Porcelain / E.max Veneers (Full Set of 16–20)
- **United States Average**: $20,000 – $35,000 USD
- **United Kingdom Private**: £10,000 – £16,000 GBP
- **Turkey**: $3,200 – $5,500 USD
- **Mexico**: $5,000 – $7,500 USD
- **Thailand**: $4,500 – $6,800 USD

## Core Patient Protection & Quality Standards
- **Accreditation**: Joint Commission International (JCI), ISO 9001:2015, Global Clinic Rating (GCR).
- **Implant Hardware**: Exclusively FDA 510(k) cleared Tier-1 worldwide brands (Straumann, Nobel Biocare, Zimmer Biomet, Hiossen) with official manufacturer warranty passports and universal internal hex standards.
- **Sterilization**: Class B pre-vacuum autoclaves operating at 134°C (273°F) with weekly biological spore testing (Geobacillus stearothermophilus).
- **Diagnostics**: In-house 3D Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) with sub-millimeter voxel resolution for guided surgical templates.
- **Travel Protocol**: Minimum 48 to 72-hour mandatory post-operative rest period in destination city before commercial air flight. Full arch permanent restorations require two trips spaced 3 to 6 months apart to allow complete titanium osseointegration.

## Key Medical Corridors
- **North America**: US & Canada to Mexico (Los Algodones / Molar City, Tijuana, Cancun). Short flights or drive-in border crossing with zero jet lag.
- **Europe & UK**: UK & Ireland to Turkey (Istanbul, Antalya) and Hungary (Budapest). Primary route for NHS dental waiting list relief.
- **Australasia**: Australia & New Zealand to Thailand (Bangkok, Phuket) and Bali. High-volume hospital dentistry combined with recovery tourism.
